f.title: Definition: serious adverse event / serious adverse reaction (incl. clinically significant event)
f.statement: For this Resolution, a serious adverse event / serious adverse reaction is any undesirable medical occurrence, at any dose, that results in death, risk of death, situations requiring hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, significant or persistent incapacity, congenital anomaly, or a clinically significant event. A clinically significant event is any event that may put the patient at risk or may require intervention to prevent death, risk of death, hospitalisation or its prolongation, significant or persistent incapacity, or congenital anomaly.
f.clause: Chapter I Section II, Art. 2 X-XI (Definitions)
f.applicability: Determines which cases fall under the 15-day notification duty of Art. 30 (row 0041).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
X - evento adverso grave/reação adversa grave: qualquer ocorrência médica indesejável, em qualquer dose, que resulte em morte, risco de morte, situações que requeiram hospitalização ou prolongamento de hospitalização já existente, incapacidade significativa ou persistente, anomalia congênita e evento clinicamente significativo;
 XI - evento clinicamente significativo: qualquer evento que possa colocar em risco o paciente ou que possa exigir intervenção, a fim de se evitar morte, risco de morte, situações que requeiram hospitalização ou prolongamento de hospitalização já existente, incapacidade significativa ou persistente, anomalia congênita;
rows.location: Chapter I Section II, Art. 2 X-XI (Definitions)

XI - clinically significant event: any event that may put the patient at risk or that may require intervention in order to avoid death, risk of death, situations requiring hospitalisation or prolongation of existing hospitalisation, significant or persistent incapacity, congenital anomaly;

f.title: Holders are responsible for PV of their products
f.statement: Medicine registration holders are responsible for pharmacovigilance actions relating to their products.
f.applicability: All holders of human medicine registrations distributed or marketed in Brazil (Art. 1).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 3º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento são responsáveis pelas ações de Farmacovigilância relacionadas aos seus produtos.

rows.quote_en: Art. 3 Holders of Registration of Medicines are responsible for the Pharmacovigilance actions related to their products.

f.title: Provide PV information requested by the authority within its deadline
f.statement: The holder must provide any and all information requested for pharmacovigilance purposes within the deadline set by the health authority.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Within the deadline set by the health authority
rows.quote: Art. 4º O Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve apresentar toda e qualquer informação solicitada, para fins de Farmacovigilância, dentro do prazo estabelecido pela autoridade sanitária.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 4 The Holder of Registration of Medicine must provide any and all information requested, for Pharmacovigilance purposes, within the deadline set by the health authority.

f.title: Answer authority requests as quickly as possible
f.statement: It is recommended that the holder provide the requested information in the shortest possible time.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: § 1º É recomendável que o Detentor de Registro de Medicamento apresente as informações de que trata o caput deste artigo no menor tempo possível.

rows.quote_en: § 1 It is recommended that the Holder of Registration of Medicine provide the information referred to in the caput of this article in the shortest possible time.

f.title: Request a justified extension if the deadline cannot be met
f.statement: If the holder cannot provide the information within the deadline, it shall submit a request for extension with justification.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: § 2º Caso o Detentor de Registro de Medicamento não possa apresentar a informação de que trata o caput deste artigo dentro do prazo estipulado pela autoridade sanitária, pedido de dilação de prazo deverá ser apresentado, acompanhado de justificativa.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deverá ser apresentado" = Mandatory; holder named in the condition; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 2 If the Holder of Registration of Medicine cannot provide the information referred to in the caput of this article within the deadline stipulated by the health authority, a request for extension of the deadline shall be submitted, accompanied by justification.

f.title: Partial data may be sent within the deadline with a delivery plan
f.statement: Partial data may be sent within the deadline set by the authority, with justification and a plan for delivering all the information requested.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Within the deadline set by the health authority
rows.quote: § 3º Dados parciais poderão ser encaminhados, dentro do prazo estabelecido pela autoridade sanitária, mediante justificativa e plano para a entrega da totalidade da informação demandada.

rows.quote_en: § 3 Partial data may be sent, within the deadline set by the health authority, with justification and a plan for delivery of all the information requested.

f.title: Appoint one RFV and a deputy and give them adequate means
f.statement: Holders must designate one pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV) and a deputy and provide adequate means for their functions, including material and human resources, communication tools and access to all relevant information sources.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 5º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem designar 1 (um) Responsável pela Farmacovigilância (RFV), bem como seu substituto, e proporcionar meios adequados para o desenvolvimento de suas funções, incluindo a disponibilização de recursos materiais e humanos, ferramentas de comunicação e acesso a todas as fontes de informação relevantes para o pleno desenvolvimento dessas atividades.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 5 Holders of Registration of Medicines must designate 1 (one) Person Responsible for Pharmacovigilance (RFV), as well as a deputy, and provide adequate means for the performance of their functions, including making available material and human resources, communication tools and access to all sources of information relevant to the full performance of these activities.

f.title: Send updated RFV and deputy details to the SNVS
f.statement: Holders shall send updated data on the RFV and deputy (name, qualifications and telephone) to the National Health Surveillance System (SNVS).

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Parágrafo único. Os dados atualizados do RFV e do seu substituto (nome, formação e telefone) deverão ser enviados pelos Detentores de Registro de Medicamento ao SNVS.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Sole paragraph. The updated data of the RFV and the deputy (name, qualifications and telephone) shall be sent by the Holders of Registration of Medicines to the SNVS.

f.title: RFV answers for the PV system, knows product profiles and resides in Brazil
f.statement: The RFV must answer for the holder pharmacovigilance system and PV matters, know the safety profiles of the holder products, reside in Brazil and be available whenever called.

rows.actor: Pharmacovigilance responsible person (RFV)
rows.quote:
Art. 6º O RFV deve:
 I - responder pelo Sistema de Farmacovigilância do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento e pelas questões relativas à Farmacovigilância;
 II - conhecer os perfis de segurança dos produtos sob responsabilidade do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento; e
 III - residir em território brasileiro e estar disponível sempre que for acionado.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve" = Mandatory; actor RFV explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 6 The RFV must:
I - answer for the Pharmacovigilance System of the Holder of Registration of Medicine and for matters relating to Pharmacovigilance;
II - know the safety profiles of the products under the responsibility of the Holder of Registration of Medicine; and
III - reside in Brazilian territory and be available whenever called upon.

f.title: Give the RFV authority and autonomy
f.statement: The RFV must be given sufficient authority and autonomy to implement changes to the PV system to promote, maintain and improve compliance with regulatory requirements; to make inclusions and suggestions in Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports; and to respond promptly to the health authority on the safety of the holder's products.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 7º O RFV deve ser dotado de autoridade e autonomia suficientes para:
 I - implementar alterações no Sistema de Farmacovigilância, com vistas a promover, manter e melhorar o cumprimento dos requisitos regulatórios;
 II - promover inclusões e sugestões nos Planos de Gerenciamento de Risco e Relatórios Periódicos de Avaliação Benefício-Risco; e
 III - responder prontamente perante a autoridade sanitária quanto à segurança de produtos sob responsabilidade do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: passive/impersonal construction, holder actor inferred ("deve ser dotado"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 7 The RFV must be given sufficient authority and autonomy to:
I - implement changes in the Pharmacovigilance System, with a view to promoting, maintaining and improving compliance with regulatory requirements;
II - make inclusions and suggestions in Risk Management Plans and Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Reports; and
III - respond promptly to the health authority regarding the safety of products under the responsibility of the Holder of Registration of Medicine.

f.title: Keep the RFV informed of emergency safety issues and benefit-risk information
f.statement: Holders must implement mechanisms so the RFV is informed of all emergency safety issues on their medicines and any other information relevant to benefit-risk evaluation.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 8º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem implementar mecanismos para que o RFV seja informado de todas as questões emergenciais relativas à segurança dos medicamentos sob sua responsabilidade, e sobre qualquer outra informação relacionada à avaliação da Relação Benefício-Risco.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 8 Holders of Registration of Medicines must implement mechanisms so that the RFV is informed of all emergency issues relating to the safety of the medicines under their responsibility, and of any other information related to the assessment of the Benefit-Risk Relationship.

f.title: Maintain a PV contingency plan including database failure
f.statement: Holders must have a contingency plan for unforeseen events, including software or hardware failure of their databases, to ensure continuity of PV activities.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 9º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem dispor de plano de contingência para imprevistos, que inclua falha de software ou hardware dos seus bancos de dados, com vistas a assegurar a continuidade das atividades de Farmacovigilância.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 9 Holders of Registration of Medicines must have a contingency plan for unforeseen events, including software or hardware failure of their databases, with a view to ensuring the continuity of Pharmacovigilance activities.

f.title: PV activities may be outsourced
f.statement: Holders may transfer to third parties the execution of any of the pharmacovigilance activities covered by the Resolution.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 10. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento podem transferir para terceiros a execução de quaisquer das atividades de Farmacovigilância de que trata esta Resolução.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "podem transferir" = Permitted; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 10. Holders of Registration of Medicines may transfer to third parties the execution of any of the Pharmacovigilance activities covered by this Resolution.

f.title: RFV and deputy cannot be outsourced; holder keeps legal responsibility
f.statement: The RFV and deputy may not be outsourced. Where PV activities are outsourced, legal and sanitary responsibility for the product remains with the holder.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 1º O RFV e seu substituto não poderão ser terceirizados.
 § 2º Nos casos de terceirização de atividades de Farmacovigilância, permanece com os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento a responsabilidade pelas obrigações legais e sanitárias relativas ao produto.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: §1 prohibition is passive ("não poderão ser terceirizados") and §2 has no modal verb; actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
§ 1 The RFV and the deputy may not be outsourced.
§ 2 In cases of outsourcing of Pharmacovigilance activities, responsibility for the legal and health obligations relating to the product remains with the Holders of Registration of Medicines.

f.title: Clear contracts for outsourced PV; subcontracting prohibited
f.statement: Where PV is outsourced, there must be clear and descriptive contractual documentation defining who is involved in each PV activity; subcontracting is prohibited.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: § 3º Nos casos de terceirização de atividades de Farmacovigilância, deve existir documentação contratual clara e descritiva definindo os envolvidos em cada atividade de Farmacovigilância, sendo vedada a subcontratação.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: passive/impersonal construction, holder actor inferred ("deve existir"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 3 In cases of outsourcing of Pharmacovigilance activities, there must be clear and descriptive contractual documentation defining those involved in each Pharmacovigilance activity, subcontracting being prohibited.

f.title: Intra-group PV: one RFV and deputy per company, documented
f.statement: PV activities between companies of the same group are not outsourcing, but each group company must keep one RFV and deputy, and the intra-group relationship must be stated in the PV documents or procedures of the companies involved.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 4º A execução das atividades de Farmacovigilância entre empresas do mesmo grupo, para efeitos desta Resolução, não será considerada terceirização, sendo necessária a manutenção de 1 (um) RFV e seu substituto por cada empresa do grupo.
 § 5º A relação entre empresas do mesmo grupo de que trata o § 4º deste artigo deverá constar em documentos ou procedimentos relacionados à Farmacovigilância das empresas envolvidas.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: passive/impersonal construction, holder actor inferred ("sendo necessária", "deverá constar"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
§ 4 The performance of Pharmacovigilance activities between companies of the same group shall not, for the purposes of this Resolution, be considered outsourcing, it being necessary to maintain 1 (one) RFV and deputy for each company of the group.
§ 5 The relationship between companies of the same group referred to in § 4 of this article shall be stated in documents or procedures relating to the Pharmacovigilance of the companies involved.

f.title: Avoid duplicate ICSR submissions when PV is outsourced
f.statement: Where PV is outsourced, duplicate submission of individual case notifications must be avoided.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: § 6º Nos casos de terceirização de atividades de Farmacovigilância, deve-se evitar a duplicidade de submissões de Notificação de casos individuais.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: passive/impersonal construction, holder actor inferred ("deve-se evitar"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 6 In cases of outsourcing of Pharmacovigilance activities, duplicate submissions of individual case Notifications must be avoided.

f.title: Outsourcing contracts must allow SNVS inspections at contractors
f.statement: The outsourcing contract must mention the possibility of SNVS pharmacovigilance inspections at the contractor premises at the authorities discretion.
f.processes: Partner & vendor oversight; Audit & inspection readiness

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: § 7º O contrato de terceirização de que trata este artigo deve mencionar a possibilidade de inspeções em Farmacovigilância, do SNVS, nas instalações de terceiros contratados, a critério das autoridades sanitárias.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: passive/impersonal construction, holder actor inferred (the contract "deve mencionar"). Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: § 7 The outsourcing contract referred to in this article must mention the possibility of Pharmacovigilance inspections by the SNVS at the premises of contracted third parties, at the discretion of the health authorities.

f.title: Implement an appropriate PV system
f.statement: Holders must implement a pharmacovigilance system appropriate to their needs that allows measures to be taken on their products when necessary.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 11. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem implementar Sistema de Farmacovigilância apropriado para suas necessidades, que permita a adoção, quando necessário, de medidas relativas aos produtos de sua responsabilidade.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 11. Holders of Registration of Medicines must implement a Pharmacovigilance System appropriate to their needs, which allows the adoption, when necessary, of measures relating to the products under their responsibility.

f.title: Locate the PV system in Brazil; elements may be abroad
f.statement: The holder PV system must be located in Brazil; elements and processes may be developed in other countries provided the operational capacity to monitor and identify problems occurring in Brazil is not compromised.
f.exceptions: Elements and processes may be run abroad if Brazilian monitoring capacity is not compromised.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 12. O Sistema de Farmacovigilância dos Detentores de Registro de Medicamento deve localizar-se em território nacional.
 Parágrafo único. É permitido que elementos e processos do Sistema de Farmacovigilância sejam desenvolvidos em outros países, desde que não haja comprometimento da capacidade operativa de monitoramento e identificação de problemas relacionados a seus produtos, ocorridos em território nacional.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve localizar-se" = Mandatory, "É permitido" correctly in exceptions; actor explicit. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 12. The Pharmacovigilance System of the Holders of Registration of Medicines must be located in national territory.
Sole paragraph. Elements and processes of the Pharmacovigilance System are permitted to be developed in other countries, provided there is no compromise of the operational capacity to monitor and identify problems related to their products occurring in national territory.

f.title: PV system must collect and process all AE information and ensure compliance
f.statement: The PV system must have the structure and performance to ensure collection and processing of all adverse event information notified to the holder from various sources, including medical sales representatives, and compliance with regulatory requirements.
f.clause: Chapter III Section I, Art. 13 I-II

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.location: Chapter III Section I, Art. 13 I-II
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve possuir" = Mandatory; subject is the DRM PV system; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.

f.title: PV system must ensure improvement, prompt authority responses and confidentiality
f.statement: The PV system must also ensure its continuous improvement through ongoing evaluation and PV self-inspection detecting non-conformities and improvement opportunities; prompt provision of information requested by the authorities for benefit-risk evaluation, including sales volumes and safety studies; and confidentiality of reports received.
f.clause: Chapter III Section I, Art. 13 III-V
f.processes: Quality system & CAPA; Submission operations; Data integrity & records

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.location: Chapter III Section I, Art. 13 III-V

f.title: Cover all safety aspects including manufacturing QA/QC in the PV system
f.statement: The PV system must be developed considering all relevant safety aspects of the medicines, including manufacturing aspects related to quality assurance and quality control.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 14. O Sistema de Farmacovigilância do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve ser desenvolvido mediante a observância de todos os aspectos de segurança relevantes de seus medicamentos, incluindo aspectos fabris relacionados à Garantia da Qualidade e ao Controle de Qualidade.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve ser desenvolvido" = Mandatory; subject is the DRM PV system; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 14. The Pharmacovigilance System of the Holder of Registration of Medicine must be developed observing all relevant safety aspects of its medicines, including manufacturing aspects related to Quality Assurance and Quality Control.

f.title: Maintain a PV system description document
f.statement: Every holder must have a document describing its PV system in detail (structure, interfaces, work processes, responsibilities and risk-management activities), keep it in its possession and send it to the authorities whenever required.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection I, Art. 15 caput and §1

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 15. Todo Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve dispor de documento com descrição detalhada de seu Sistema de Farmacovigilância, contendo informações quanto à sua estrutura, interfaces, processos de trabalho, responsabilidades e atividades relacionadas ao gerenciamento de risco.
 § 1º O documento de que trata o caput deste artigo deve ficar sob posse do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento e ser encaminhado para as autoridades sanitárias, sempre que exigido.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection I, Art. 15 caput and §1
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 15. Every Holder of Registration of Medicine must have a document with a detailed description of its Pharmacovigilance System, containing information on its structure, interfaces, work processes, responsibilities and activities related to risk management.
§ 1 The document referred to in the caput of this article must remain in the possession of the Holder of Registration of Medicine and be sent to the health authorities whenever required.

f.title: Describe partnerships and outsourcing in the system description
f.statement: National and international partnerships and outsourced PV activities, with the levels and forms of relationship of each party, must appear in the system description; unusual partnerships involving a particular medicine must be flagged.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection I, Art. 15 §§2-3

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
§ 2º As parcerias nacionais e internacionais, bem como a terceirização de atividades de Farmacovigilância deverão constar da descrição do sistema, bem como os níveis e formas de relacionamento de cada parte integrante do Sistema de Farmacovigilância.
 § 3º Parcerias diferentes daquelas usuais envolvendo algum medicamento em especial deverão ser assinaladas no documento de que trata o caput deste artigo.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection I, Art. 15 §§2-3

rows.quote_en:
§ 2 National and international partnerships, as well as the outsourcing of Pharmacovigilance activities, shall appear in the system description, as well as the levels and forms of relationship of each party of the Pharmacovigilance System.
§ 3 Partnerships different from the usual ones involving a particular medicine shall be indicated in the document referred to in the caput of this article.

f.title: RFV full-time, health graduate, experienced, working in Brazil
f.statement: The RFV must be available full time, hold a health-area degree, have proven PV experience and knowledge, and perform their activities in Brazil.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 16. O RFV deve estar disponível em tempo integral, possuir graduação na área de saúde, ter experiência e conhecimentos comprovados em Farmacovigilância, e desempenhar suas atividades em território nacional.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection II, Art. 16
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve" = Mandatory; below 90: grammatical subject is the RFV, holder actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en: Art. 16. The RFV must be available full time, hold a degree in the health area, have proven experience and knowledge in Pharmacovigilance, and perform their activities in national territory.

f.title: Keep RFV CV, job description and absence procedure available
f.statement: The following must be available to the authorities: a summary CV of the RFV with qualifications, training and PV experience; a summary of functions and job description; and the procedure applicable during RFV absences.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection II, Art. 17

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 17. As seguintes informações sobre o RFV devem estar à disposição das autoridades sanitárias:
 I - resumo de seu currículo, descrevendo informações relevantes sobre suas principais qualificações, treinamentos e experiência em Farmacovigilância;

 Art. 19. Não deve haver sobreposições não justificáveis, bem como lacunas, nas responsabilidades dos envolvidos no Sistema de Farmacovigilância do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento.

f.title: Train PV staff and interfacing functions such as sales and customer service
f.statement: PV teams must be properly trained; training also covers people in sales, customer service and any other function interfacing with product safety information.

rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection III, Art. 20

Art. 20. Teams involved in Pharmacovigilance must be duly trained, so that their functions and responsibilities are adequately performed.

f.title: Approved training programmes, schedules and retained training records
f.statement: The holder must have duly approved training programmes with execution schedules and keep training records for PV inspection purposes.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection III, Art. 21

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 21. O Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve dispor de programas devidamente aprovados de treinamento, bem como dos respectivos cronogramas de execução.

f.title: Document all PV activities with traceable, controlled documents
f.statement: Documentation is an essential part of the PV system covering all its activities; the system must have tools to manage PV documents; documents and information must be traceable; documents must be written, approved and distributed only by expressly designated persons and made available only to authorised, trained staff.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 22. A documentação é parte essencial do Sistema de Farmacovigilância e deve abarcar todas as atividades relacionadas a esse sistema.
 Art. 23. O Sistema de Farmacovigilância do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve contar com instrumentos capazes de gerenciar documentos pertinentes à execução de atividades de Farmacovigilância.
 § 1º Os documentos e informações relacionados ao Sistema de Farmacovigilância devem ser rastreáveis pelo Detentor de Registro de Medicamento.
 § 2º Os documentos de que trata o caput deste artigo devem ser redigidos, aprovados e distribuídos exclusivamente por pessoas expressamente designadas.
 § 3º Os documentos de que trata o caput deste artigo somente devem ser disponibilizados a funcionários devidamente autorizados e previamente treinados quanto à aplicação de tais documentos.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection IV, Arts. 22-23

rows.quote_en:
Art. 22. Documentation is an essential part of the Pharmacovigilance System and must cover all activities related to that system.
Art. 23. The Pharmacovigilance System of the Holder of Registration of Medicine must have instruments capable of managing documents pertinent to the performance of Pharmacovigilance activities.
§ 1 Documents and information related to the Pharmacovigilance System must be traceable by the Holder of Registration of Medicine.
§ 2 The documents referred to in the caput of this article must be written, approved and distributed exclusively by expressly designated persons.
§ 3 The documents referred to in the caput of this article must only be made available to duly authorised employees previously trained in the application of such documents.

f.title: Have and follow clear SOPs for PV activities
f.statement: Holders must have and follow SOPs or other documents governing PV activities, which must be legible and clear to avoid divergent interpretation.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 24. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem possuir e seguir POP ou qualquer outro tipo de documento que balize as atividades relacionadas à Farmacovigilância.
 § 1º Os documentos de que trata o caput deste artigo devem ser legíveis e claros, a fim de evitar interpretações divergentes durante sua execução.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection IV, Art. 24 caput and §1
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.

Art. 24. Holders of Registration of Medicines must have and follow SOPs or any other type of document that guides the activities related to Pharmacovigilance.
§ 1 The documents referred to in the caput of this article must be legible and clear, in order to avoid divergent interpretations during their execution.

f.title: SOPs required for case handling, literature screening, follow-up and duplicates
f.statement: SOPs or other documents must describe: collection, processing, coding, classification, assessment and notification to the competent authority; regular analysis to capture adverse events from scientific literature sources; follow-up of notifications without known clinical outcome; and detection of duplicate notifications.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection IV, Art. 24 §2 I-IV

f.statement: SOPs or other documents must also describe: RMP preparation and implementation; PBRER preparation; PV self-inspection; staff training; document management; and signal detection and review.

f.title: Maintain a PV database and keep notifications 20 years
f.statement: The holder must have a database for systematic, up-to-date and routine recording of activities and information on adverse event notifications received; notifications must be traceable and kept in a systematic and secure medium under the holder responsibility for at least 20 years.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.deadline: Retain notifications for at least 20 years

 Parágrafo único. As Notificações de que trata o caput deste artigo devem ser rastreáveis e mantidas em meio sistemático e seguro sob responsabilidade do Detentor de Registro de Medicamento por, no mínimo, 20 (vinte) anos.
rows.location: Chapter III Section II Subsection V, Art. 25

Art. 25. The Holder of Registration of Medicine must have a database for the systematic, up-to-date and routine recording of the activities and information related to the Notifications of Adverse Events received.
Sole paragraph. The Notifications referred to in the caput of this article must be traceable and kept in a systematic and secure medium under the responsibility of the Holder of Registration of Medicine for at least 20 (twenty) years.

f.title: Submit Art. 30 notifications through VigiMed
f.statement: Transfer of information to the SNVS must follow this Resolution and specific legislation. Holders (DRM) shall send the notifications covered by Art. 30 through the electronic notification system provided by Anvisa, VigiMed.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 26. A transferência de informações para o SNVS deve observar o disposto nesta Resolução e em legislação específica.
 § 1º Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento (DRM) deverão encaminhar as notificações objeto do art. 30 desta Resolução por meio do sistema eletrônico de Notificação disponibilizado pela Anvisa - o VigiMed.

f.title: Send notifications through VigiMed per ICH E2B(R3), manually or by XML import
f.statement: Holders shall send notifications to the SNVS through VigiMed according to ICH E2B(R3), using the manual interface or import of compatible XML files, grouped or individual, generated in their own PV systems.
f.clause: Chapter III Section II Subsection V, Art. 26 §2 (wording by RDC 967/2025)
f.applicability: Amended by RDC 967/2025 (Resolução Anvisa nº 967 of 18/03/2025, published D.O.U. 20/03/2025, in force 365 days after publication, i.e. about 20 March 2026); the quoted text is the RDC 967/2025 wording shown in the AnvisaLegis compiled text. f.title: Self-inspection programme
f.statement: The holder must have a PV self-inspection programme describing frequency, responsibilities, procedures and documents to follow, and its execution schedule.

f.title: Self-inspect yearly (max every 2 years), record CAPA, keep 5 years, include contractors
f.statement: The holder must perform preferably one PV self-inspection per year, not exceeding 2 years, keeping records with the required CAPA; self-inspection records must be kept at least 5 years and may be requested by the SNVS at any time; self-inspection must also cover contractor activities and premises when PV is outsourced.

Art. 28. O Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve realizar, preferencialmente, 1 (uma) autoinspeção no Sistema de Farmacovigilância por ano, não excedendo o prazo de 2 (dois) anos para sua a realização, mantendo em seu poder o registro dessa atividade, com a descrição das Ações Corretivas e Preventivas necessárias ao processo de melhoria contínua.
 § 1º As Autoinspeções em Farmacovigilância devem ser registradas em documentos a serem mantidos pelo Detentor de Registro de Medicamento por, no mínimo, 5 (cinco) anos, e seus registros poderão ser solicitados pelo SNVS a qualquer tempo.
 § 2º A Autoinspeção em Farmacovigilância deve compreender também as atividades e instalações de terceiros, nos casos de terceirização das atividades de Farmacovigilância.

The Holder of Registration of Medicine must carry out, preferably, 1 (one) self-inspection of the Pharmacovigilance System per year, not exceeding a period of 2 (two) years for carrying it out, keeping in its possession the record of this activity, with a description of the Corrective and Preventive Actions necessary for the continuous improvement process.

f.title: Follow up pregnancy and pre-conception exposures
f.statement: Holders are responsible for following up and assessing all cases of medicine exposure in pregnant patients and their children after birth when known; for pre-conception exposure they must likewise follow up and assess the case, considering the half-life of the substance or metabolites and long-term effects.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 36. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento são responsáveis por acompanhar e avaliar todos os casos de exposição a medicamentos de pacientes grávidas e seus filhos após o nascimento, quando do seu conhecimento.
 Parágrafo único. Diante da exposição pré-gestacional, os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento são igualmente responsáveis por acompanhar e avaliar o caso, levando em consideração ainda, a meia-vida da substância ou de seus metabólitos, bem como os efeitos a longo prazo.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; below 90: "são responsáveis por acompanhar" is a responsibility statement, not a modal verb. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 36. Holders of Registration of Medicines are responsible for following up and assessing all cases of exposure to medicines of pregnant patients and their children after birth, when they become aware of them.
Sole paragraph. In the case of pre-gestational exposure, Holders of Registration of Medicines are likewise responsible for following up and assessing the case, also taking into account the half-life of the substance or its metabolites, as well as long-term effects.

f.title: Prepare PBRERs including all AE notifications and lack-of-efficacy assessment
f.statement: Holders must prepare PBRERs to review and evaluate the safety profile of their products; they must include all AE notifications received, including non-serious ones and events in other countries, and an assessment of lack-of-efficacy cases in the period.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 37. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem elaborar Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco, para rever e avaliar o perfil de segurança de seus produtos.
 Art. 38. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem incluir todas as Notificações de Eventos Adversos recebidas no Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco, inclusive as não graves, ainda que o evento tenha ocorrido em outro país.
 Parágrafo único. O Relatório Periódico de Avaliação Benefício-Risco também deve contemplar uma avaliação sobre os casos de Inefetividade Terapêutica ocorridos no período, tanto aqueles abarcados pelo § 1º do art. 30, quanto os demais casos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches text; level follows the Portuguese modal; actor explicit; statement adds nothing. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 37. Holders of Registration of Medicines must prepare a Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report to review and evaluate the safety profile of their products.
Art. 38. Holders of Registration of Medicines must include all Notifications of Adverse Events received in the Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report, including non-serious ones, even if the event occurred in another country.
Sole paragraph. The Periodic Benefit-Risk Evaluation Report must also contain an assessment of the cases of Lack of Therapeutic Effect occurring in the period, both those covered by § 1 of Art. 30 and the other cases.

f.title: PBRER format, content and frequency per specific regulation; include case, signal and off-label data

f.title: Archive PBRER copies and provide on request
f.statement: Holders must keep an archived copy of the PBRER and present it to the competent authority whenever requested.

f.title: Routine benefit-risk evaluation; report changes to Anvisa immediately
f.statement: The holder must maintain routine benefit-risk evaluation of its products; any change in the balance must be reported to Anvisa immediately, including new data from post-registration studies indicating signals or benefit-risk changes.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 41. O Detentor de Registro de Medicamento deve manter rotina de avaliação da Relação Benefício-Risco de seus produtos.
 Parágrafo único. Qualquer alteração no equilíbrio entre os benefícios e os riscos de seus produtos deve ser informada imediatamente à Anvisa, inclusive novos dados que possam existir provenientes de estudos pós-registro, indicando a ocorrência de Sinais ou mudanças na Relação Benefício-Risco dos medicamentos.
rows.review_note: Review: no change. Re-translation: agrees. Double-check: quote matches; "deve manter"/"deve ser informada imediatamente" = Mandatory; below 90: sole paragraph passive, actor inferred. Translation verified: quote_en faithful in meaning, modal force, numbers and actor.
rows.quote_en:
Art. 41. The Holder of Registration of Medicine must maintain a routine of assessment of the Benefit-Risk Relationship of its products.
Sole paragraph. Any change in the balance between the benefits and risks of its products must be reported immediately to Anvisa, including new data that may exist from post-registration studies, indicating the occurrence of Signals or changes in the Benefit-Risk Relationship of the medicines.

f.title: Prepare an RMP for registration where required
f.statement: Holders must prepare a Risk Management Plan, presented at registration in the situations set by current regulatory frameworks, describing routine PV actions and the proposed additional actions to minimise the risks of each medicine, as applicable.
f.applicability: Situations set by current regulatory frameworks.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: Art. 42. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem elaborar Plano de Gerenciamento de Risco, a ser apresentado por ocasião do registro nas situações previstas nos marcos regulatórios vigentes, que descreva as ações de rotina de Farmacovigilância, bem como contemple as ações adicionais propostas, para a minimização de riscos de cada medicamento, no que couber.

Holders of Registration of Medicines must prepare a Risk Management Plan, to be presented at registration in the situations provided for in the current regulatory frameworks, describing routine Pharmacovigilance actions and covering the proposed additional actions for the minimisation of the risks of each medicine, as applicable.

f.title: Apply special rigour to RMPs for NMEs, vaccines, biosimilars and other cases
f.statement: Special attention and rigour must be given to RMP preparation for: new synthetic, semi-synthetic and biological molecular entities; vaccines; biologics registered via the comparability pathway; significant registration changes affecting product safety; when unexpected harm is identified; or when requested by the competent authority.

f.statement: The holder must consider updating the RMP as new safety data emerge and on use in populations not studied pre-registration; the updated RMP must be petitioned to Anvisa electronically.

f.title: Prepare a risk minimisation plan for important risks
f.statement: Where there are important identified or potential risks or critical information warranting additional minimisation actions, or when requested by the authority, a Risk Minimisation Plan must be prepared and petitioned to Anvisa as part of the RMP at registration, or at any time for products already marketed.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)

When there are important Identified Risks, important Potential Risks or critical information warranting additional actions, with a view to minimising the risks in question, or when requested by the health authority, a Risk Minimisation Plan must be prepared, to be petitioned to Anvisa as part of the Risk Management Plan, at the time of registration, or at any time, in cases where the medicine has already been marketed.

f.title: Justify the minimisation method, plan effectiveness evaluation and cover unstudied use
f.statement: The holder must justify the method proposed to execute its Risk Minimisation Plan and provide for evaluating the effectiveness of the proposed actions; situations of probable use not adequately studied pre-registration must be covered by the plan.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)

 § 2º Situações em que o medicamento tenha um provável uso não estudado adequadamente no período pré-registro devem estar contempladas no Plano de Minimização de Risco.

§ 1 The Holder of Registration of Medicine must justify the method proposed for executing its Risk Minimisation Plan and provide for the assessment of the effectiveness of the actions proposed to minimise the risks of the medicine in question.
§ 2 Situations in which the medicine has a probable use not adequately studied in the pre-registration period must be covered in the Risk Minimisation Plan.

f.title: Support announced or unannounced PV inspections
f.statement: Holders may be subject to announced or unannounced SNVS PV inspections at any time; they must promptly provide all requested documents, make staff available for interviews and allow access to the PV database.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote:
Art. 47. Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento podem receber, a qualquer tempo, Inspeções em Farmacovigilância, conduzidas pelo SNVS, anunciadas ou não, sempre que houver necessidade de avaliação do cumprimento da legislação vigente.

Os Detentores de Registro de Medicamento devem apresentar prontamente toda a documentação solicitada pelos agentes do SNVS, bem como disponibilizar seu pessoal para entrevistas e permitir o acesso a seu banco de dados de Farmacovigilância, para fins de verificação do cumprimento das exigências legais.

f.title: Definition: spontaneous and solicited notifications (incl. sales-representative queries)
f.statement: A spontaneous notification is an unsolicited communication by a health professional or consumer to a company, regulatory authority or other organisation describing one or more adverse reactions in a patient who received one or more medicines, not derived from a study or any organised data collection system; questions put by sales representatives to health professionals are also included. A solicited notification is one derived from organised data collection systems, including clinical trials, registries, post-approval patient-use programmes and other patient support programmes.
f.clause: Chapter I Section II, Art. 2 XX-XXI (Definitions)
f.applicability: Defines the 'spontaneous or solicited' cases within the scope of the 15-day duty in Art. 30 (row 0041).

f.title: Definition: adverse reaction; spontaneously reported events count as adverse reactions for notification
f.statement: An adverse reaction is any harmful or undesirable, unintended response to a medicine at doses usually used in humans for prophylaxis, diagnosis, therapy or modification of physiological functions; unlike an adverse event, it is characterised by a suspected causal relationship. For notification purposes, an event reported spontaneously meets the definition of an adverse reaction even if the relationship is unknown or not stated.
f.clause: Chapter I Section II, Art. 2 XXIII (Definitions)
f.applicability: For notification purposes, a spontaneously reported event meets the adverse reaction definition even if the causal relationship is unknown or not stated.

rows.actor: Marketing authorisation holder (Detentor de Registro de Medicamento, DRM)
rows.quote: XXIII - reação adversa: qualquer resposta prejudicial ou indesejável, não intencional, a um medicamento, que ocorre nas doses usualmente empregadas no ser humano para profilaxia, diagnóstico, terapia da doença ou para a modificação de funções fisiológicas. Diferentemente do Evento Adverso, a Reação Adversa caracteriza-se pela suspeita de relação causal entre o medicamento e a resposta prejudicial ou indesejável. Para fins de notificação, se um evento for relatado espontaneamente, mesmo que a relação seja desconhecida ou não declarada, ele atende à definição de reação adversa;

rows.quote_en: XXIII - adverse reaction: any harmful or undesirable, unintended response to a medicine, occurring at doses usually used in humans for prophylaxis, diagnosis, therapy of disease or for the modification of physiological functions. For notification purposes, if an event is reported spontaneously, even if the relationship is unknown or not stated, it meets the definition of an adverse reaction;

f.title: Definition: lack of therapeutic effect (therapeutic ineffectiveness)
f.statement: For this Resolution, therapeutic ineffectiveness is the absence or reduction of the expected therapeutic response of a medicine under the conditions of use indicated in the package leaflet.

f.title: Definition: unexpected adverse reaction (assessed against the Brazilian package leaflet)
f.statement: An unexpected adverse reaction is an adverse reaction whose nature, severity, specificity or clinical outcome is not consistent with the information in the national (Brazilian) package leaflet of the medicine concerned, even if such reactions are described for the respective pharmacological class.
f.clause: Chapter I Section II, Art. 2 XXIV (Definitions)
f.applicability: Expectedness (e.g. for follow-up prioritisation under Art. 30 §3, row 0044) is judged against the Brazilian leaflet (bula nacional), not class labelling.
